tasks.title: Allow a project's own commands
tasks.summary: ws adapt adds an allow rule per command in [commands], in the shape the adapter names.
acceptance: cargo check --all-targets gives a rule for cargo check, and make lint for make lint, not make
an environment prefix gives both forms, and a compound command a rule per part
a command that pushes or publishes gives no rule
ws doctor reports a missing rule, and core names no agent

tasks.title: Tell workers what they can't edit
tasks.summary: ws brief names a background task's files and docs under a folder the adapter protects.
acceptance: a background task's brief names a protected doc and says to give the text under Gotchas
a foreground task's brief doesn't, and neither does a project without that adapter

tasks.title: Quiet ws validate and fix ws evidence check
tasks.summary: Prose commits, the import's marker and long lists of files to come stop filling ws validate, and ws evidence check says a done task has landed.
acceptance: a prose commit and the import's marker don't warn, and a plain hash not in the repository still does
more than three missing files in a workstream collapse to one line, and three or fewer stay listed
ws evidence check on a done task exits 0 and names its commit

tasks.title: Docs say what is true
tasks.summary: The gate's list of gaps, the results, the README and the plan.
acceptance: the gate says what was closed and what wasn't
ws adapt on the pilot branch adds rules for its real commands, and ws validate there is shorter (manual)

outOfScope: getting past an agent's protection of its config folder
scope.rule: Close the gaps the gate listed, and nothing else.
